# SaaS Subscription Agreement **Date:** {{date}} --- ## Parties This SaaS Subscription Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between: **Provider:** The Provider identified in the Order Form annexed to this Agreement ("the Provider"). **Customer:** {{signerName1}}, contactable at {{signerEmail1}} ("the Customer"). --- ## 1. Subscription Details The Provider agrees to provide the Customer with access to the Provider's Contract Lifecycle Management Platform ("the Platform") subject to the terms of this Agreement. - **Plan:** {{field2}} - **Number of Licensed Users:** {{field3}} - **Customer Address:** {{field1}} The Platform includes the following core modules as part of the subscription: - **Contract Summarisation** — AI-powered instant summaries of any contract, extracting key terms, obligations, dates, and risk areas in seconds - **Contract Creation** — Intelligent drafting with clause libraries, approved template management, and self-serve contract generation - **Contract Review** — Automated risk identification, obligation extraction, and deviation analysis against approved playbooks - **Contract Negotiation** — Collaborative redlining and approval workflows natively integrated with Microsoft Word and Microsoft Teams - **Contract Repository** — Centralised, searchable storage with metadata tagging, key date tracking, and automated renewal alerts - **Contract Insights** — Dashboards, reporting, and portfolio-wide analytics to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities - **Microsoft Teams Integration** — Request, review, approve, and sign contracts directly from Microsoft Teams without switching applications ## 2. Subscription Term This Agreement shall commence on the date first written above and shall continue for an initial period of **twelve (12) months** ("the Initial Term"). Upon expiry of the Initial Term, the subscription shall automatically renew for successive **twelve (12) month** periods (each a "Renewal Term") unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least **sixty (60) days** prior to the end of the then-current term. ## 3. Fees and Payment The Customer shall pay the subscription fees as set out in the Order Form attached to this Agreement. All fees are: - Quoted in **GBP (£)** and exclusive of VAT - Invoiced **annually in advance** unless otherwise agreed - Due within **thirty (30) days** of the date of invoice - Non-refundable and non-cancellable during any committed term The Provider reserves the right to increase fees upon renewal by providing at least **sixty (60) days** written notice prior to the start of a Renewal Term. ## 4. Provider's Obligations The Provider agrees to: - Provide access to the Platform in accordance with the service levels set out in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) - Maintain platform availability of at least **99.9%** measured on a monthly basis, excluding scheduled maintenance - Provide technical support during UK business hours (09:00-17:30 GMT/BST, Monday to Friday) with priority support for Enterprise plan customers - Implement and maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures in accordance with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II - Process Customer data only in accordance with the Data Processing Agreement (DPA) annexed to this Agreement - Deliver onboarding, training, and dedicated customer success support as outlined in the Order Form - Provide regular platform updates and new feature releases at no additional cost during the subscription term ## 5. Customer's Obligations The Customer agrees to: - Use the Platform only for lawful business purposes and in compliance with the Provider's Acceptable Use Policy - Maintain the confidentiality of all user credentials and notify the Provider immediately of any suspected unauthorised access - Ensure that the number of active users does not exceed the licensed user count without prior agreement - Provide reasonable cooperation during onboarding, integration, and any support activities - Not copy, modify, reverse-engineer, or create derivative works of the Platform or any part thereof - Not sublicense, transfer, or otherwise make the Platform available to any third party without the Provider's prior written consent ## 6. **Additional Notes or Special Requirements:** [text|req|signer1|Notes]
## 7. Intellectual Property All intellectual property rights in the Platform, including but not limited to software, algorithms, AI models, documentation, and branding, remain the exclusive property of the Provider. Nothing in this Agreement transfers any intellectual property rights to the Customer. The Customer retains all rights in the data and content uploaded to the Platform ("Customer Data"). The Customer grants the Provider a limited, non-exclusive licence to process Customer Data solely for the purpose of providing the Platform services. The Provider may use anonymised and aggregated data derived from the Customer's use of the Platform to improve its services, provided that such data cannot be used to identify the Customer or any individual. ## 8. Confidentiality Each party agrees to keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement ("Confidential Information"). Confidential Information shall not be disclosed to any third party without the disclosing party's prior written consent, except as required by law, regulation, or court order. This obligation shall survive termination of the Agreement for a period of **three (3) years**. ## 9. Limitation of Liability To the maximum extent permitted by law: - The Provider's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Customer in the **twelve (12) months** preceding the claim - Neither party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or business opportunity - Nothing in this Agreement excludes or limits liability for fraud, death, or personal injury caused by negligence, or any other liability that cannot be excluded by law ## 10. Termination Either party may terminate this Agreement: - For convenience at the end of any term by providing the required notice as set out in Section 2 - Immediately upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within **thirty (30) days** of receiving written notice of the breach - Immediately upon written notice if the other party enters into administration, liquidation, or any analogous insolvency process Upon termination, the Provider shall make the Customer's data available for export for a period of **thirty (30) days**, after which it shall be securely deleted in accordance with the DPA. ## 11. Data Protection Both parties agree to comply with all applicable data protection legislation, including the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. The terms of data processing are set out in the Data Processing Agreement annexed to this Agreement. The Provider shall act as a Data Processor on behalf of the Customer (as Data Controller) in respect of any personal data processed through the Platform. ## 12. Governing Law and Disputes This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales. --- ## Signatures Please sign below to confirm acceptance of the terms of this Agreement. **Customer Signature:** [sig|req|signer1] **Date Signed:** [date|req|signer1] **Provider Authorised Signatory:** [sig|req|signer2] **Date Signed:** [date|req|signer2]

# Employment Contract **Date:** {{date}} --- ## Parties This Employment Contract ("Contract") is entered into by and between: **Employer:** Acme Corporation Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales (Company No. 09876543), with its registered office at 200 Business Park, London, EC1A 1BB, UK ("the Employer"). **Employee:** {{signerName1}}, contactable at {{signerEmail1}} ("the Employee"). --- ## 1. Position and Duties The Employer agrees to employ the Employee in the following capacity: - **Job Title:** {{field1}} - **Department:** {{field2}} - **Reporting To:** Head of {{field2}} - **Place of Work:** 200 Business Park, London, EC1A 1BB, UK (with hybrid working arrangements as agreed) The Employee shall perform such duties as are reasonably assigned and consistent with the role described above. The Employee may be required to undertake additional duties as reasonably requested by the Employer from time to time. ## 2. Start Date and Probationary Period The employment shall commence on the date first written above. The Employee will be subject to a **probationary period of six (6) months**, during which either party may terminate the employment by giving **one (1) week** written notice. Successful completion of the probationary period will be confirmed in writing by the Employer. ## 3. Remuneration The Employee shall receive a gross annual salary of **{{field3}}**, payable in equal monthly instalments on or before the last working day of each calendar month, by direct credit transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. The salary will be subject to statutory deductions including income tax, National Insurance contributions, and any pension contributions as applicable. The Employee's salary will be reviewed annually, but there is no obligation on the Employer to award an increase. ## 4. Working Hours The Employee's normal working hours shall be **37.5 hours per week**, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:30, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break. The Employee may be required to work additional hours from time to time to fulfil the duties of the role, for which no additional payment will be made. The Employee agrees to opt out of the 48-hour weekly working time limit under the Working Time Regulations 1998. This opt-out may be revoked by the Employee at any time by giving **three (3) months** written notice to the Employer. ## 5. Holiday Entitlement The Employee is entitled to **25 days** paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to all UK public bank holidays. The holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Holiday entitlement is accrued on a pro-rata basis during the first and final years of employment. Up to **five (5) unused days** may be carried forward to the following year with prior approval from the Employee's line manager. ## 6. Pension The Employee will be automatically enrolled in the Employer's workplace pension scheme in accordance with the Pensions Act 2008. The Employer will contribute **5%** and the Employee will contribute **3%** of qualifying earnings. The Employee may opt out of the pension scheme at any time in accordance with the scheme rules. ## 7. Sickness and Absence The Employee is entitled to **ten (10) days** paid sick leave per calendar year, subject to compliance with the Employer's sickness reporting procedures. Any absence beyond this entitlement may be paid at the Employer's discretion or in accordance with Statutory Sick Pay (SSP) provisions. The Employer reserves the right to require the Employee to attend a medical examination by a doctor nominated by the Employer, at the Employer's expense. ## 8. Employee Acknowledgements By initialling below, the Employee confirms they have read and understood sections 1 through 7 of this Contract: **Employee Initials:** [initial|req|signer1]
The Employee confirms the following: [check|req|signer1] I confirm that the information I have provided is accurate and complete, and I have disclosed any matters that may affect my employment [check|req|signer1] I agree to comply with the Employer's policies, procedures, and codes of conduct as may be in force from time to time [check|req|signer1] I acknowledge that this Contract is subject to satisfactory completion of pre-employment checks, including right to work verification and references
**Additional Notes or Special Conditions:** [text|req|signer1|Notes]
## 9. Confidentiality During and after the term of employment, the Employee shall not disclose to any third party any confidential information relating to the Employer's business, clients, finances, trade secrets, or intellectual property, except as required in the proper performance of their duties or as required by law. This obligation shall survive termination of employment indefinitely in respect of trade secrets and for a period of **twelve (12) months** in respect of other confidential information. ## 10. Notice Period After successful completion of the probationary period, either party may terminate this Contract by giving the following written notice: - **During first two years of service:** one (1) month - **After two years of service:** three (3) months The Employer reserves the right to make a payment in lieu of notice (PILON) at its sole discretion. ## 11. Restrictive Covenants For a period of **six (6) months** following the termination of employment (however caused), the Employee shall not: - Solicit or entice away any employee, contractor, or client of the Employer - Engage in or be concerned with any business that competes directly with the Employer within the United Kingdom These restrictions are considered by the parties to be reasonable and necessary for the protection of the Employer's legitimate business interests. ## 12. Data Protection The Employer will process the Employee's personal data in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. Full details are set out in the Employer's Privacy Notice for Employees, a copy of which has been provided to the Employee. ## 13. Governing Law This Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Contract shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales. --- ## Signatures Please sign below to confirm acceptance of the terms of this Contract. **Employee Signature:** [sig|req|signer1] **Date Signed:** [date|req|signer1] **Employer Authorised Signatory:** [sig|req|signer2] **Date Signed:** [date|req|signer2]

1. SERVICES AND SCOPE

1.1 Service Package
Palm agrees to provide Client with the following service package:

Service Package: {{field1}}

The Service Package includes access to Palm's identity fabric platform, which connects Client to verified business data, compliance monitoring tools, and real-time reporting capabilities across relevant jurisdictions.

1.2 Core Service Components
Depending on the Service Package selected, Palm will provide:

(a) Business Identity Verification: Real-time verification of business entity information, including legal name, EIN, registration status, and jurisdiction of formation.

(b) Compliance Monitoring: Continuous monitoring of business entities for compliance status changes, including business license renewals, good standing status, and regulatory filings.

(c) Data Access and Integration: Access to Palm's API and platform interfaces for integration with Client's systems and workflows.

(d) Onboarding Services: Pre-filled data integration to streamline Client's business onboarding processes.

(e) Reporting and Analytics: Real-time compliance reporting, entity status updates, and analytics dashboards.

1.3 Service Limitations
Services are subject to the availability and accuracy of data from third-party government agencies and regulatory bodies. Palm makes commercially reasonable efforts to maintain data accuracy but does not guarantee the completeness or timeliness of data from external sources beyond Palm's control.

1.4 Service Modifications
Palm reserves the right to modify, update, or enhance the Services, provided that such modifications do not materially diminish the core functionality described in this Agreement. Palm will provide Client with reasonable advance notice of material changes.

Contract Value: {{field3}}

(b) Annual subscriptions are payable in advance upon execution of this Agreement and on each anniversary thereafter.

3. DATA RIGHTS AND USAGE

3.1 Data Ownership
(a) Palm Data: All business verification data, compliance information, and platform intelligence provided by Palm remains the property of Palm and its data providers. Client receives a limited license to use Palm Data solely for Client's internal business purposes during the term of this Agreement.

(b) Client Data: Client retains all rights to data submitted by Client to the Palm platform ("Client Data"). Client grants Palm a limited license to use Client Data solely to provide the Services.

3.2 Permitted Use of Palm Data
Client may use Palm Data to:
(a) Verify business identities for onboarding, underwriting, or compliance purposes
(b) Monitor ongoing compliance status of business relationships
(c) Assess risk and perform due diligence on business entities
(d) Integrate verified business data into Client's internal systems and workflows

3.3 Prohibited Uses
Client shall not:
(a) Resell, redistribute, or sublicense Palm Data to third parties without Palm's prior written consent
(b) Use Palm Data to create competing products or services
(c) Scrape, copy, or cache Palm Data beyond what is necessary for permitted uses
(d) Reverse engineer or attempt to extract Palm's proprietary algorithms or methodologies
(e) Use Palm Data in violation of applicable laws, including data privacy and consumer protection regulations

3.4 Data Accuracy and Updates
Palm provides data "as-is" from government and regulatory sources. While Palm employs quality control measures, Client acknowledges that:
(a) Data accuracy depends on source data quality and timeliness
(b) Palm is not liable for errors in third-party source data
(c) Client should independently verify critical information where appropriate
(d) Palm will provide updates and corrections as they become available from source agencies

3.5 Data Privacy and Security
